map.构建带UTM参数的追踪链接，用于广告流量来源分析: Build tracking links with UTM parameters for analysing ad traffic sources
map.📖 查看「UTM参数构建器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "UTM Parameter Builder User Guide"
map.UTM 构建：在网址后拼接 ?utm_source=&utm_medium=&u: UTM building: append ?utm_source=&utm_medium=&utm_campaign=&utm_term=&utm_content= (last two optional) to the URL; batch mode splits URLs line by line and applies the same parameter set to each.
map.已有同名 utm_* 参数会先被删除再写入，参数插在 # 锚点之前；中文、空格与: Existing utm_* keys are removed before writing, and parameters are inserted before the # anchor; Chinese characters, spaces and special characters are encoded by URLSearchParams. URL, source, medium and campaign are required; empty term and content are omitted.
map.内容utm_content（可选，用于区分广告版本）: Content utm_content (optional, to distinguish ad versions)
map.批量网址（每行一个，可选；填写后按行生成）: Batch URLs (one per line, optional; each line is generated separately)
map.请填写网址、来源、媒介、活动名称（必填项）: Enter the URL, source, medium and campaign (all required)
map.为不同渠道/活动生成带 UTM 的追踪链接。: Generate UTM-tagged tracking links for different channels and campaigns.
map.规范 utm_source/medium/campaign 命名便于归因。: Standardize utm_source / medium / campaign naming for clean attribution.
map.批量生成多活动链接导入投放后台。: Generate links for many campaigns in bulk and import them into the delivery platform.
map.来源 wechat、媒介 cpc、活动 spring_sale → 原链接后接: Source wechat, medium cpc and campaign spring_sale appends ?utm_source=wechat&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=spring_sale to the original link, so GA can split by channel.
map.在“批量网址”框每行填一个链接（如两条落地页），同一组 wechat / soc: Enter one link per line in the batch box (for example two landing pages); the same wechat / social / summer_promo parameters generate one link per line, each copyable, and the whole list can be exported as CSV.

map.，本工具用 URLSearchParams 自动编码；部分后台解析异常，建议全小: ; this tool encodes them automatically with URLSearchParams. Some backends still parse them incorrectly, so lower-case English with underscores is safer.
map.URL、来源 utm_source、媒介 utm_medium、活动 utm_c: URL, utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign are required; term and content are optional and are omitted when empty. Batch mode requires the same four items, with URLs entered one per line.
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不会上传到服务器: The tool runs entirely in the front end; data is never uploaded to a server.
map.建议在主流浏览器（Chrome/Safari/Firefox/Edge）中使用: Use a mainstream browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge).
map.链接中已有同名 utm_* 参数会被替换而不是累加；参数插在 # 锚点之前，中文: Existing utm_* keys in the link are replaced rather than duplicated; parameters are inserted before the # anchor, and Chinese characters and spaces are encoded automatically.
